_about: Default rules for ptk deal. To change them, copy this file to ptk-rules.json beside your deals database (or pass --rules) and edit the copy; keys you leave out keep these defaults. Citations are starting points for counsel to confirm, not a title opinion.

attorney._modes: flagged: an opinion is needed only when a task marked requires_attorney was raised and not later resolved by the data. always: every deal needs one. price: flagged, plus any deal priced at or above price_threshold.

messaging._about: Routine reminders go out without a person approving each one, but only by email, only to a party who has already received a person-approved message on the same deal, never to a party marked do_not_contact, and never more than max_reminders times per task. Everything else is drafted for approval.

TX.authority: The 120-day watch is an internal follow-up window, not a statutory deadline. Tex. Nat. Res. Code §91.402 sets payment timing and lets the payor require a signed division order first (§91.402(c)). Confirm with counsel.

NM.authority: The 120-day watch is an internal follow-up window. New Mexico Oil and Gas Proceeds Payment Act, NMSA 1978 §70-10-3: first payment within six months after the first sale, then within 45 days after the end of each month of receipt. Confirm with counsel.

NAME_VARIANT.requirement: Spellings differ only in case or punctuation; confirm it's the same person or entity.

CHAIN_GAP.requirement: Find the missing link: search the grantor/grantee index (ptk names) for how this grantor acquired, pull the image, and add it to the takeoff.

OVER_CONVEYANCE.requirement: The grantor conveyed more than it held. The examiner decides what passed.

DUHIG_CANDIDATE.requirement: Warranty deed conveyed more than the grantor held. The examiner decides whether Duhig applies.

MI_RESERVE_IGNORED.requirement: Fix the takeoff: model a mineral reservation by conveying less, then rerun ptk deal verify.

NPRI_REVIEW.requirement: NPRI in the chain. The examiner confirms fixed vs floating and what it burdens.

NPRI_INCOMPLETE.requirement: Fix the takeoff: an NPRI row needs npri_kind and npri_value.

NPRI_BURDENS_UNREADABLE.requirement: Fix the takeoff: npri_burdens must be all, conveyed, retained or owners:A;B.

NPRI_BURDENS_NOTHING.requirement: Fix the takeoff: the NPRI matched no minerals on its date.

ALL_NEEDS_RELATIVE_INTEREST.requirement: Fix the takeoff: an ALL row needs 'all' or 'x of grantor'.

UNKNOWN_ESTATE.requirement: Fix the takeoff: estate must be MI, NPRI or ALL.

UNREADABLE_FRACTION.requirement: Fix the takeoff: a fraction couldn't be read.

MERGER_REVIEW.requirement: An owner holds minerals burdened by its own NPRI. The examiner decides merger.

MINERALS_NOT_WHOLE.requirement: Title doesn't account for the whole mineral estate. Finish the run before relying on the seller's share.

ORRI_REVIEW.requirement: ORRI in the lease chain. The examiner confirms proportionate reduction and what it burdens.

ORRI_INCOMPLETE.requirement: Fix the lease chain: an ORRI row needs orri_value.

ORRI_BURDENS_UNREADABLE.requirement: Fix the lease chain: orri_burdens must be all, conveyed, retained or owners:A;B.

ORRI_BURDENS_NOTHING.requirement: Fix the lease chain: the ORRI matched no working interest on its date.

WI_NOT_WHOLE.requirement: The lease chain doesn't account for 8/8 of the working interest. Finish the chain.

ROYALTY_MISSING.requirement: Add the lessor royalty to the lease's root row.

DOUBLE_FRACTION.requirement: Double fraction. Van Dyke (Tex. 2023) presumes a 1/8 double fraction in an older instrument meant the whole estate, but the presumption is rebuttable (rebutted in Clifton v. Johnson, Tex. 2026: a fixed 1/128). Mineral and royalty grants can come out differently. The examiner construes it.

TERM_INTEREST.requirement: Term interest. Pull production for the whole term window; the examiner decides whether it expired.

BLANKET_CONVEYANCE.requirement: Blanket county conveyance. The examiner decides what it reached.

NPRI_LANGUAGE.requirement: Record which mineral attributes each party holds (executive right, bonus, rentals, royalty).

POWER_OF_ATTORNEY.requirement: Get the recorded power of attorney and confirm it covers this act.

FIDUCIARY_CAPACITY.requirement: Get the letters testamentary, trust instrument or certificate of trust, or court order showing authority to convey.

RELINQUISHMENT_ACT.requirement: Relinquishment Act land (Tex. Nat. Res. Code ch. 52, subch. F, §§52.171-.190). Run the GLO checklist; the examiner confirms the State's interest.

TOP_LEASE.requirement: Top lease. The examiner decides when the base lease ended.

NO_IMAGE.requirement: Pull the instrument image and link it on the runsheet.

IMAGE_MISSING.requirement: The linked image isn't in the images folder. Pull it again.

NO_RECORDING_REF.requirement: Add the volume and page or instrument number from the image.

BAD_DATE.requirement: Fix the date on the runsheet from the image (full four-digit year).

FILED_BEFORE_EXECUTED.requirement: Check both dates against the image and correct the runsheet.

WORD_NUMERAL_MISMATCH.requirement: Words and numerals disagree. The examiner decides which controls; a correction instrument may be needed.

LIEN_OR_LITIGATION.requirement: Find the release or the outcome of record. If none, request a release from the lienholder.

UNACKNOWLEDGED.requirement: Get the instrument acknowledged or re-executed. Texas: once it has been of record two years it may be cured under CPRC §16.033(a)(8) and (c); the examiner confirms.

SPOUSE_NOT_JOINED.requirement: New Mexico: if this is community real property, a conveyance without both spouses is void (NMSA 40-3-13), unless a recorded power of attorney (§47-1-7) or the spouse's written ratification covers it. The examiner decides the cure; usually a ratification by the spouse or the spouse's heirs.

AFFIDAVIT_OF_HEIRSHIP.requirement: Heirship. Texas: confirm the affidavit is recorded in every county with minerals and the decedent's domicile county; after 5 years of record it is prima facie evidence (Est. Code §203.001), not a cure. New Mexico: the examiner decides whether probate is needed.

SMALL_ESTATE_AFFIDAVIT.requirement: A small estate affidavit passes only homestead real property in Texas (Est. Code §205.006); in New Mexico it passes personal property (NMSA §45-3-1201), with a separate affidavit for a residence (§45-3-1205). It doesn't pass these minerals. The examiner decides between probate and a heirship judgment.

LEASE_ROYALTY_MISSING.requirement: Abstract the lease royalty from the image.

LEASE_TERM_MISSING.requirement: Abstract the lease primary term from the image.

MISSING_COLUMNS.requirement: The runsheet is missing required columns. Start from ptk template runsheet.csv.

LESSOR_NOT_OWNER.requirement: A lessor owns nothing per the ledger. Check the lease against the chain.

DOUBLE_LEASE.requirement: An owner is lessor under two leases. The examiner decides which lease controls.

NPRI_EXCEEDS_ROYALTY.requirement: The NPRI burden exceeds the royalty. The examiner reviews the reservation language.

NPRI_ON_UNLEASED.requirement: NPRIs burden unleased minerals. The examiner decides how they're paid.

BURDENS_EXCEED_LEASE.requirement: Royalty plus ORRIs exceed 8/8. Check the lease and the ORRI instruments.

NO_LESSEE.requirement: Add lessee shares to the lease in the project file.

NPRI_NOT_RATIFIED.requirement: The NPRI owner hasn't ratified pooling (Montgomery v. Rittersbacher, pooled units; allocation wells are unsettled). Check whether the NPRI instrument grants pooling authority, then request a ratification of the pooling only (ratifying the lease doesn't reduce a fixed NPRI: ConocoPhillips v. Hahn, Tex. 2024), or confirm it's paid on tract production.

DECK_NOT_WHOLE.requirement: A tract's revenue interests don't add to 1. Fix the title data before computing what the buyer will be paid.

PARTICIPATION_NOT_WHOLE.requirement: Participation factors don't add to 1. Fix the weights in the project file.

NO_TITLE.requirement: A tract in the well has no ledger position. Add its takeoff.

NPRI_KIND.requirement: An NPRI kind must be fixed or floating.

SELLER_SHORTFALL.requirement: The seller owns less than it sold. Acquisitions decides: cure, price adjustment, or a smaller conveyance.

NRI_SHORTFALL.requirement: Title shows less NRI than the seller represented. Acquisitions decides: cure or price adjustment.

SELLER_NOT_IN_CHAIN.requirement: The seller holds nothing of record in this tract or lease on the effective date. Check names (ptk names) and the takeoff, then tell acquisitions.

SELLER_CONVEYED_AFTER_EFFECTIVE.requirement: The seller conveyed part of this interest after the effective date. Check for a prior or double sale before closing.

NMA_DIFFERS.requirement: Title NMA differs from the deal's NMA. Confirm the price basis with acquisitions.

NPRI_KIND_DIFFERS.requirement: The deal and the title disagree on fixed vs floating. The examiner decides.

NO_TITLE_FILES.requirement: Add the takeoff (or lease chain) for this asset to its title section, then rerun ptk deal verify.

TITLE_FILE_MISSING.requirement: A title file named in the deal doesn't exist. Fix the path.

LEASE_NOT_NAMED.requirement: Name the lease this asset buys (lease.id), or each well's leases and their shares (participation).

WELLBORE_NO_WELLS.requirement: List the wells this wellbore buy covers, with each lease's share of each well.

TITLE_FILE_ERROR.requirement: A title file couldn't be read. Fix the row named in the message.

INTAKE_LEGAL_UNREADABLE.requirement: The legal description can't be located. Send it back to acquisitions for a complete description.

INTAKE_LEGAL_REVIEW.requirement: The legal description parsed with a question. Confirm it against the deed or lease.

INTAKE_COUNTY_MISMATCH.requirement: The county doesn't match the state or the legal description. Confirm with acquisitions.

INTAKE_COUNTY_UNKNOWN.requirement: The county isn't in the county table. Add its records coverage (ptk counties --checklist).

INTAKE_INTEREST.requirement: The interest bought can't be read or is out of range. Get the exact interest from acquisitions.

INTAKE_NMA_MISMATCH.requirement: Interest x gross acres doesn't equal the stated NMA. Confirm which one the price is based on.

INTAKE_ACRES_MISMATCH.requirement: Gross acres don't match the area of the legal description. Check for lots, irregular sections or a typo.

INTAKE_LAND_STATUS.requirement: Give the land status (fee, state or federal) for every New Mexico tract, from BLM MLRS and NMSLO records.

INTAKE_MARITAL_STATUS.requirement: Get the seller's marital status; it decides who must sign.

INTAKE_SPOUSE_MISSING.requirement: The seller is married but no spouse is named. Get the spouse's name for the conveyance.

INTAKE_SELLER_CONTACT.requirement: No email or mailing address for the seller. Get one so curative requests can go out.

INTAKE_NO_AGREEMENT.requirement: No signed purchase agreement or letter of intent is listed. Add it to the deal's documents.

INTAKE_EFFECTIVE_DATE.requirement: No effective date. Title is verified as of the effective date; get it from the agreement.

INTAKE_PRICE_MISSING.requirement: No price on the deal. Add it for the closing statement.

INTAKE_WELL_API.requirement: A well API number looks wrong (Texas 42-, New Mexico 30-). Check it against the RRC or OCD.

INTAKE_MAPCHECK.requirement: The tract didn't map cleanly. Check the description against the survey or PLSS layer.

INTAKE_SELLER_REF.requirement: An asset names a seller id that isn't in the sellers list.

DIVISION_ORDER_PENDING.requirement: Waiting on the operator's division order or transfer confirmation.

DO_DECIMAL_MISMATCH.requirement: The division order decimal doesn't match the title decimal. Don't sign it: send the operator the title math and ask for a corrected division order.

PAYMENT_OVERDUE.requirement: No payment by the watch date. Ask the payor whether the interest is in suspense and what it needs.

PAYMENT_IN_SUSPENSE.requirement: The payor shows the interest in suspense. Find out why and send what it needs.

PAY_DECIMAL_MISMATCH.requirement: The decimal paid differs from the title decimal. Send the payor the title math.

PAYEE_NAME_VARIANT.requirement: The payee name on the statement differs from the buyer's name. Confirm the payor's owner record.

NO_RESPONSE.requirement: No response after the maximum number of reminders. Call the party.

OPINION_REQUIREMENT.requirement: Satisfy the examining attorney's title requirement.

checklists.requirement: Run the {county} County records to the effective date and bring them down to today. ptk plan --county {county} shows where the records are.
Look up every well on {tract} in the RRC (operator, lease number, status) and list it on the asset so each operator gets a transfer notice.
School land: check the GLO mineral file for Relinquishment Act status or a free royalty reserved to the State before relying on the chain.
checklists.authority: Tex. Nat. Res. Code §§51.054, 51.201 (free royalty); ch. 52, subch. F, §§52.171-.190 (Relinquishment Act); confirm with counsel

checklists.requirement: University Lands: the minerals are likely owned by the Permanent University Fund, so a private mineral or royalty deed likely passes nothing. The seller may hold an ORRI or leasehold instead. Check mineral status (not surface ownership) and find out what the seller actually holds.
Check the appraisal district roll for the seller's mineral account and get a tax certificate showing no delinquent taxes.
If {tract} is part of the seller's homestead, both spouses must sign the conveyance. Confirm homestead status or get the spouse's joinder.
checklists.authority: Tex. Fam. Code §5.001; confirm with counsel

checklists.requirement: Read the lease and any operating agreement for consent-to-assign and preferential-right provisions; get the consents and waivers before closing.
Change of operator: file RRC Form P-4 and confirm the buyer's P-5 organization report and financial assurance are active.
checklists.authority: 16 Tex. Admin. Code §3.58 (P-4), §3.1 (P-5 organization report), §3.78 (financial assurance); confirm with counsel

checklists.requirement: Confirm land status for {tract} (fee, State trust land under the NMSLO, or federal under the BLM) from BLM MLRS and NMSLO records.
Run the {county} County clerk records to the effective date and bring them down to today. New Mexico has no county mineral appraisal roll.

Federal minerals: if the United States owns the minerals, a private mineral or royalty deed likely passes nothing. The seller may hold a federal lease interest or an ORRI instead. Check mineral status (not surface ownership), find out what the seller actually holds and re-paper the deal.

State trust land: if the State owns the minerals (NMSLO), a private mineral or royalty deed likely passes nothing. The seller may hold a state lease interest or an ORRI instead. Check mineral status (not surface ownership) and find out what the seller actually holds.

File the transfer with the BLM within 90 days of signing: record title on Form 3000-3, operating rights on Form 3000-3a. ORRIs are filed for record, not approved. Record title and operating rights transfers take effect only when the BLM approves them (effective date per §3106.74). Confirm bonding.
checklists.authority: 43 CFR 3106.10(f), (h) and (i); 3106.41 (forms); 3106.42 (ORRIs); 3106.74 (effective date); confirm with counsel

checklists.requirement: File the assignment with the New Mexico State Land Office within 100 days for the Commissioner's approval, with the filing fee; an unapproved assignment doesn't bind the State. Confirm bonding. (ORRIs don't need approval.)
checklists.authority: NMSA 1978 §19-10-13; 19.2.100.40 and 19.2.100.43 NMAC; confirm with counsel

checklists.requirement: Community property: if the interest is community real property, both spouses must sign the conveyance (NMSA 40-3-13), unless a recorded power of attorney (§47-1-7) covers it. The package names the spouse as a grantor; confirm both sign, or get the attorney's sign-off on separate property.
Check the OCD for compulsory pooling orders covering each well (NMSA 70-2-17); elections and risk charges (capped at 200%) change what the buyer receives.
Read the lease and any operating agreement for consent-to-assign and preferential-right provisions; get the consents and waivers before closing.
Change of operator: file OCD Form C-145 and confirm the buyer's OGRID and financial assurance.
checklists.authority: 19.15.9.9 NMAC (change of operator), 19.15.9.8 NMAC (OGRID), 19.15.8 NMAC (financial assurance); confirm with counsel

checklists.requirement: Collect a signed W-9 from each seller for the closing statement and 1099-S reporting.
